goal: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before changing the code, I need to understand the main components involved in this functionality, their responsibilities, and how they interact with each other. I also want to identify which parts of the system may be affected by the modification.

responsibilities: exposes reservation create, cancel and check-in endpoints, delegating to LibraryFacade; ReservationController, StudyRoomController, StudentController

responsibilities: Swing screens for choosing room, seat and time, and confirming reservations; WizardState, SeatSelection, AreaSelection, …

elements.name: Seat booking service
responsibilities: validates student, room, seat and slot, then creates and saves reservations; LibraryFacade, ReservationManager, StudyRoomManager

elements.name: MySQL database
